inv.desc_en:
Great opportunity to transfer a fully operational restaurant.

TRANSFER PRICE: €180,000
plus 4% fees plus VAT to be paid by the acquiring party.

Bar-restaurant license.

Restaurant in operation and with demonstrable profitability.

Capacity for approximately 80 diners.

Very well located in l'esquerre de l'eixample of Barcelona. C/Mallorca.
Very close to hospitals and near the Mercat del Ninot, and the Industrial School.

Transfer, with a new minimum contract for 10 years with a monthly rent of €2,250 + VAT. (IBI and community fees included).

Fully equipped with facilities and a complete kitchen. In operation.

Linear facade of the commercial premises 10m – 2 large shop windows - bright.

With bar, furniture, complete kitchen, smoke vent, refrigerators, new toilets, staff toilet, possibility of installing a toilet for people with reduced mobility.

Transfer of activity license and complete installations and furniture.

Public parking very close, 10m away on the same sidewalk.

Very important! Visits will not be attended during working hours, and not previously arranged.

In any case, visits should always be between 4 pm and 6 pm.

If you want better information, please provide personal data of the company and the interested representative, and they will be duly attended to.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

*************************************************************************

You can arrange visits or request better information by WhatsApp at tel. 6. 7. 4. 6. 7. 7. 0. 6. 7. Coordinator Mr. Jmanuel.
